title: Inbox
description: A mail client page in three panes: folders and labels, a message list with unread states, and a reading pane with a reply box — composed from KATA parts.
usage: Three panes, one page. The folder rail and the message rows are page glue; the avatars, badges, buttons, search input and reply textarea are catalog parts. Rows carry two states worth keeping when you wire real data: .sel for the open message and .unread for the bold subject and dot. Below 900px the reading pane steps aside, the way mail apps do.
